verdict.rationale: Ghostty ships as a native app on macOS (official .dmg, Homebrew cask) and Linux (distro packages, systemd integration), and its single config system, including runtime reload, is documented for both. Windows support appears only for the libghostty-vt library, which is a developer building block rather than the Ghostty terminal app, so it earns no credit. Default keybindings also differ per platform by design. Missing for 10: a Windows build of the Ghostty terminal itself, explicit documentation that one config file is portable unchanged across platforms, and independent corroboration of cross-platform config parity.
